title: User equipment,web server and system for estimating location using federated learning

pse.problem: The patent addresses the problem of indoor positioning while protecting user privacy in a distributed learning environment.
pse.solution_function: The system uses federated learning to generate and update a wide-area model for estimating the location coordinates of a terminal based on Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) information. The server generates, updates, and transmits the wide-area model and initial weight information to terminals. Terminals measure RSSI information, use it to calculate their own weight information that minimizes the error between estimated and actual coordinates, and transmit this weight information back to the server for model update.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a server with components like a model generation unit, transmitter, weight reception unit, and model update unit. Terminals have components such as an information measuring unit, receiving unit, terminal weight information calculating unit, and transmitting unit.
pse.solution_implementation: The server generates a wide-area model (multilayer neural network algorithm) that takes RSSI information as input and outputs estimated location coordinates. Terminals measure RSSI information from access points, use it to calculate their own weight information, and transmit this back to the server for model update. The server updates the wide-area model using the received terminal weight information and the number of RSSI inputs for each terminal.
pse.effect: The system provides a solution for indoor positioning while preserving user privacy by utilizing federated learning and RSSI information.
